title.zh: Copilot Managed Runtime 应用与 New Agent 企业级双轨 ALM 晋升流水线
title.en: Dual-Track Enterprise ALM Promotion Pipeline for CMR Apps and New Agents

label.zh: 轨道 A：Copilot Managed Runtime Apps 代码级 Git / CI/CD 晋升轨（@microsoft/cmr-cli）
label.en: Track A: Copilot Managed Runtime Apps Git-Native & CI/CD Promotion (@microsoft/cmr-cli)

label.zh: 轨道 B：Microsoft Copilot Harness Agents 声明式定义与 Solution 晋升轨（msagent CLI）
label.en: Track B: Microsoft Copilot Harness Agents Declarative & Solution Promotion (msagent CLI)

label.zh: 跨环境配置隔离与双管理中心安全门禁（MAC + PPAC Governance Gates）
label.en: Cross-Environment Isolation & Dual-Admin Governance Gates (MAC + PPAC)

label.zh: 1. 从个人环境克隆或 BYOB 初始化
label.en: 1. Clone from Personal Env or BYOB Init

detail.zh: ms app clone --app <id> 提取源码，并在目标环境执行 ms app create --repo none --environment-id <target>
detail.en: ms app clone --app <id>, then ms app create --repo none --environment-id <target>

label.zh: 2. Stage Overlay 与共享连接校验

detail.zh: 配置 ms.<stage>.config.json 覆盖连接与表；校验 sharedConnectionId 的 allowedActions
detail.en: Configure ms.<stage>.config.json deltas; validate allowedActions on shared connections

label.zh: 3. GitHub Actions SPN 打包与发布

detail.zh: 开启 AllowExternalArtifactDeployment；通过 ms-app-pack 与 ms-app-deploy 自动上线
detail.en: Enable AllowExternalArtifactDeployment; run ms-app-pack and ms-app-deploy via SPN

label.zh: 1. msagent 克隆定义与 Git 纳管

detail.zh: 拉取 settings.mcs.yml 与 workflows；将 .mcs/ 与 .config/agent.config.json 加入 .gitignore
detail.en: Pull settings.mcs.yml & workflows; exclude .mcs/ and .config/agent.config.json in .gitignore

label.zh: 2. 多环境部署槽位与连接绑定

detail.zh: msagent deployment create 注册 dev/test/prod；按引用名执行 connection update
detail.en: Register dev/test/prod targets; bind target connections via connection update

label.zh: 3. 云端评测门禁与正式发布

detail.zh: msagent agent deploy 推送草稿 -> agent eval run 评测 -> --publish 发布（或走 Solution 管道）
detail.en: msagent agent deploy draft -> agent eval run -> --publish (or Dataverse Solution pipeline)

label.zh: BAP API / Dataverse SPN 授权

detail.zh: 无 Dataverse 环境通过 BAP API 赋权 EnvironmentAdmin（必须用 Enterprise App Object ID）
detail.en: Non-Dataverse envs grant EnvironmentAdmin via BAP API using Enterprise App Object ID

label.zh: 环境组策略、ACP 与 CSP 沙盒

detail.zh: 默认放行 19 个 Entra 认证一等连接器并拦截任意 HTTP 动作；强制 iframe CSP
detail.en: Allows 19 first-party Entra connectors, blocks open HTTP actions, enforces iframe CSP

label.zh: Purview 审计 (519) 与离职接管

detail.zh: 监控 RecordType 519 与 P75 延迟；通过 ms admin add owner 移交源码与环境
detail.en: Track RecordType 519 & P75 latency; run ms admin add owner for offboarding handover
